describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with dense, shaggy brown fur covering most of its body. Its overall build, head shape, and limbs resemble a bear, with a stout torso, thick neck, and four sturdy legs ending in clawed paws. Integrated into the fur are several glossy, hard, dark reddish-brown to black structures resembling the exoskeleton of a rhinoceros beetle: a single large curved horn on the forehead, a smooth shield-like plate over the shoulders and chest, and two oval, ridged, wing-cover-like shells on the mid-back and on the outer hindquarter. Two rows of small oval holes with dark rims run along the side of the torso through lighter fur, and dark segmented bands encircle each leg near the joints. The animal stands with all four feet on the ground, casting a faint shadow.

describe.description: The image shows a single large quadruped standing in profile facing right. It has the overall shape, thick shaggy brown fur, head, muzzle, small rounded ears, sturdy legs, clawed paws, and very short tail of a brown bear. Integrated into the furry body are several glossy dark reddish-brown beetle-like features: a long upcurved black horn with a notch rising from the center of the forehead, a large domed smooth shield over the shoulders behind the neck, large ribbed oval wing-cover-like shells lying on the mid-back and on the rear flank, two rows of small oval holes in the fur along the side of the torso, and thin dark segmented bands encircling the legs.
